provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pandemic Legacy: Season 1 rules (Z-Man Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Structures nearby; disease cubes in 4 supply piles by color
A research station in each city with a starting research station sticker (at first only Atlanta)
Infection rate marker on the leftmost space; outbreaks marker and cure markers in place
Shuffle the Infection Deck; infect the first cities with 3, 2 and 1 cubes as directed
Deal each player a hand of City cards and give each a role
Build the Player Deck: City and Event cards with Epidemic cards shuffled in for your difficulty
Read the Mission Briefing and this month's objectives
Stickers add setup steps as the campaign goes on - check the rulebook's setup page each game
Take turns: 4 actions, draw 2 Player cards, infect cities
